title: Constrained and Composite Sampling via Proximal Sampler
abstract: arXiv:2602.14478v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study two log-concave sampling problems: constrained sampling and composite sampling. First, we consider sampling from a distribution proportional to $e^{-f}$ on a convex set $K\subset\mathbb R^d$, where $f$ is convex. Using an epigraph lifting, we reduce this problem to uniform sampling up to a one-dimensional exponential tilt over a convex set in $\mathbb R^{d+1}$. We then apply the proximal sampler to the lifted distribution. We develop an unbiased implementation of its restricted Gaussian oracle by using the cutting-plane method and rejection sampling, requiring only a separation oracle for $K$ and evaluation and subgradient oracles for $f$, without relying on projections or barrier functions.   Second, we study composite sampling from $e^{-f-h}$, where $f$ and $h$ are closed and convex. This structure arises naturally in Bayesian inference, where $f$ represents data fidelity and $h$ encodes prior information. By applyin

translated_title: 通过近端采样器实现约束采样与复合采样

tldr: 该论文提出基于近端采样器的框架，通过上图提升、割平面方法与拒绝采样，实现了凸集上约束采样及复合密度 $e^{-f-h}$ 的采样，且仅需分离、求值和次梯度预言机，摆脱了对投影和障碍函数的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a proximal sampler-based framework for constrained sampling on convex sets and composite sampling of densities $e^{-f-h}$, using epigraph lifting, cutting-plane methods, and rejection sampling, requiring only separation, evaluation, and subgradient oracles without relying on projections or barrier functions.
